name: Offer
description: A deal over your photo: the offer in big type, what it is for, the small print and a button. For a sale, a discount, a bundle or an opening offer.

tag.label: Label
tag.description: A short label above the offer, e.g. THIS WEEK ONLY. Leave empty for none.

offer.label: Offer
offer.description: The deal in a few characters, e.g. 20% OFF or 2 FOR 1.

item.label: What it is for
item.description: What the offer is on, e.g. Every cut and colour.

detail.label: Small print
detail.description: When and how, e.g. Mon to Thu, book online or call in. Leave empty for none.

cta.label: Button
cta.description: The button's words, e.g. Book now. Leave empty for none.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: Your account handle, top right, e.g. @yourbrand. Leave empty for none.

photo.label: Photo
photo.description: The photo behind the words: a person, a place or a product, with no words in it. Upload one, pick one from the Library, or let AI make one. Without it, your brand colours show.

sample_data.detail: Monday to Thursday, 9am to 4pm. Book online or call in.
